prompt_prefix_by_task.m5-weekly-plans:
Done when every check below holds. Run each check yourself before you say you're done.

- `npm test` exits 0 and reports no failing tests.
- In a scratch folder, `node <repo>/bin/subtrack.js add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-02 --file subs.json` exits 0, and adding plans with `--every month` and `--every year` to the same file still works.
- The Meal kit costs €59.90 × 52 ÷ 12 a month, rounded to the nearest cent: €259.57 (cut off it would be €259.56). A €12 weekly plan costs €52.00 a month.
- Wherever subtrack shows a monthly cost or a monthly total, a weekly plan is shown with that monthly cost: run every command in the README that prints one, on a file that has a weekly plan in it.
- Every monthly cost is rounded to the nearest cent, not cut off: a yearly plan of €100.06 shows €8.34 a month (cut off it would be €8.33).
- `node <repo>/bin/subtrack.js renewals --today 2026-10-24 --within 7 --file subs.json` lists the Meal kit on 30 Oct (it charges every 7 days from 2 Oct).
